data: What is the value of the computational time (in ms) of the orange plus marker where the head cluster size (kh) is approximately 20,000?

The orange plus marker represents the empirical computational time, which is the measured time on a K40 GPU. The x-axis shows the size of the head cluster (kh), and the y-axis shows the computational time in milliseconds (ms). The orange plus marker at approximately 20,000 on the x-axis corresponds to a computational time of around 100 ms. Therefore, the value of the computational time at this point is approximately 100 ms.
